WITH la_males AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        l.id_bioguide,
        l.first_name,
        l.last_name,
        MIN(CAST(SUBSTR(lt.term_start, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) as first_term_year
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    JOIN legislators l ON lt.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
    WHERE l.gender = 'M' 
        AND lt.state = 'LA'
    GROUP BY l.id_bioguide, l.first_name, l.last_name
),
years_31_49 AS (
    SELECT 31 as year_num
    UNION ALL SELECT 32 UNION ALL SELECT 33 UNION ALL SELECT 34 UNION ALL SELECT 35
    UNION ALL SELECT 36 UNION ALL SELECT 37 UNION ALL SELECT 38 UNION ALL SELECT 39 UNION ALL SELECT 40
    UNION ALL SELECT 41 UNION ALL SELECT 42 UNION ALL SELECT 43 UNION ALL SELECT 44 UNION ALL SELECT 45
    UNION ALL SELECT 46 UNION ALL SELECT 47 UNION ALL SELECT 48 UNION ALL SELECT 49
),
years_to_check AS (
    SELECT 
        y.year_num,
        lm.id_bioguide,
        lm.first_term_year,
        (lm.first_term_year + y.year_num) as check_year
    FROM years_31_49 y
    CROSS JOIN la_males lm
),
active_on_dec31 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        ycb.id_bioguide,
        ycb.first_term_year,
        ycb.check_year
    FROM years_to_check ycb
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON ycb.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(lt.term_start, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) <= ycb.check_year
        AND (CAST(SUBSTR(lt.term_end, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) > ycb.check_year OR lt.term_end IS NULL)
)
SELECT 
    (check_year - first_term_year) as years_elapsed,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id_bioguide) as dist
